decisions.01_init_road: From scratch first: Qwen3 tokenizer + logit-KL from an open Qwen3-*-Base teacher. Qwen3 conversion = P11, optional, on user instruction only. (user 2026-09-27)
decisions.02_corpus: Open-licensed sources PLUS a research-exception arm; every document carries licence + commercial_safe; research_only never enters a shippable arm. (user 2026-09-27)
decisions.03_gpus: 1 H100 per screen arm; 4 H100 DDP for full backbone and SFT runs. (user 2026-09-27)
decisions.04_reference_deletion: P1-Z, after the port gate passes, user-confirmed. (user 2026-09-27)
decisions.05_package: lexhybrid; Python>=3.11; torch>=2.5; pytorch_lightning>=2.4; Hydra; editable install; no sys.path shims
decisions.06_tokenizer_eos: Qwen3 tokenizer (Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base); EOS = Qwen3 <|endoftext|> id 151643; student vocab_size 151936
decisions.07_special_tokens: SFT-only, never in KD: <|q|>, <|cite|>, <|c1|>..<|c16|>, <|s1|>..<|s64|>, <|unanswerable|>, <|passage|>, <|/passage|>, <|question|>, <|answer|> (87 <= 267 free ids)
decisions.08_teacher: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base by default; Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base only if P4-U measures peak <= 70 GB at 4096 rows on 4xH100 and step time <= 1.6x
decisions.09_kd_loss: online; (1-a)CE + a*T^2*KL(teacher_T || student_T), a=0.5, T=2; per 512-token slab under checkpointing; teacher gets per-document position_ids + block-diagonal mask; doc-boundary label mask applies to KL
decisions.10_model: 12 layers, dim 768, 12 heads, pattern M3 M3 M3 A L L L M3 M3 A M3 M3, norm_topology hybrid, tfla_impl exact, d_state 128, mamba3_chunk_size 128, mlstm_chunk_size 128, mlstm_forget_gate_bias_init 3.0, rope_theta 500000, dropout 0.0, tied embeddings, max_position_embeddings 8192
decisions.11_param_counting: non_embedding = total - embedding - (lm_head if untied); both counts always reported; base = 104.1M non-embedding / 220.8M total; never called 150M
decisions.12_seq_lengths: screens 2048-token rows; main pretraining 4096; long-context stage 8192; 32K/128K numbers are efficiency-only
decisions.13_corpus_tooling: LER scrub flair/ner-german-legal (PER/RR/AN/STR); dedup datasketch MinHash 5-gram/128 perms/Jaccard>=0.8; replay FineWeb-2 deu_Latn (ODC-By)
decisions.14_retrieval_verifier: bm25s + BAAI/bge-m3 + RRF + BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3; NLI MoritzLaurer/mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli-multilingual-nli-2mil7, threshold pre-registered before calibration
decisions.15_ceilings: gpt-oss-120b with the same passages (Qwen3-235B does not fit 4x80 GB) or skipped and said so; frontier API only as an optional USER ACTION, never training data
decisions.16_statistics: 2 seeds per screen arm, 3 for any claim; claim = paired mean > one baseline seed SD AND sign at >=2/3 seeds; bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples by question) beside, never instead
decisions.17_legacy_operators: only configs/model/hybrid_legal_legacy.yaml may set scan_impl/tfla_impl legacy; PPL/probe-only (no cached decode)
decisions.18_environment: uv project, one uv.lock (macOS arm64 + Linux x86_64); .python-version 3.11; torch==2.11.0 (PyPI on macOS, 2.11.0+cu128 from the PyTorch cu128 index on Linux; torch 2.12+ has no cu128 build); every env built with uv sync --locked and verified by scripts/check_env.py (user 2026-09-27)
decisions.19_ci: GitHub Actions .github/workflows/ci.yml on every push/PR: lint, test (Linux, py3.11+3.12), hygiene (pushed tree), package; weekly network smoke + macOS clean install; GPU checks on the cluster; inert until the user pushes (user 2026-09-27)

rules.R1: Equivalence: operator changes pass fp64 oracle <=1e-6 and model-logit gate <=1e-4 before ticking
rules.R2: Memory: no change regresses inference memory parity with FlashAttention at 16K (ref 7.09 vs 7.15 GB)
rules.R3: One lever per arm; non-parameter-matched arms carry their delta in every table
rules.R4: Predict first: italic prediction + bar written before submission; RESULTS reports prediction -> outcome incl. wrong ones
rules.R5: Seed band before claim: 2 seeds screens, 3 for claims; decision 16 verbatim; no t-test on 2 dof
rules.R6: Checkpoint budget: SAVE_TOP_K=0 on arms, 1+last on pipeline inputs; outputs/ on SCRATCH_ROOT; du before every submission
rules.R7: One compiler cache per measured point; one shape per process; effective_chunk_size read back
rules.R8: No legacy operators outside hybrid_legal_legacy.yaml; every recurrent yaml pins tfla_impl (and scan_impl when it has mamba layers)
rules.R9: Licence discipline: licence/jurisdiction/commercial_safe on every doc; unknown licence refused; research_only never in a commercial_safe shard; no research_only checkpoint leaves the cluster
rules.R10: Never train on GPT/Claude/Gemini API outputs; synthetic data from open-weight teachers only
rules.R11: LER scrub before pretraining and before any index build; verifier rejects PER-naming answers; 'who was the party' is a refusal
rules.R12: Every number in analysis/ carries a job id + log path; ARCH fingerprint at construction; run_metadata with .sync_stamp; tooling is not a tick
rules.R13: Tests with the code: every code box ships its tests; marker taxonomy (plan 8.2); skips carry reasons; coverage floor never lowered without a note; flaky test = defect
rules.R14: One gate, three venues: validate.sh --ci == CI test job selection; Mac-impossible checks run in CI or on the cluster (plan 8.3); red CI blocks the current box
